article_title: Yemen government announces all-out war to reclaim land from Houthis

tasks.prompt: What major development does the article report?
options: The Houthis agreed to leave Sanaa peacefully.
Yemen's internationally recognised government announced operations to retake all Houthi-held territory.
Saudi Arabia withdrew from every part of the conflict.
The Bab al-Mandab Strait was opened under a new peace agreement.
tasks.correct_answer: Yemen's internationally recognised government announced operations to retake all Houthi-held territory.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: נשיא ממשלת תימן המוכרת בין־לאומית הכריז על מבצעים צבאיים להשבת כל השטח שבידי החות'ים.

tasks.prompt: What recent Houthi gain helped prompt the government's fierce announcement?
options: Control of Saudi oil fields near Riyadh
A formal alliance with the Yemeni government
The capture of all government institutions in Aden
Control of Yemen's coastline, including the Bab al-Mandab shipping lane
tasks.correct_answer: Control of Yemen's coastline, including the Bab al-Mandab shipping lane
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המתקפה החות'ית בחודש הקודם השתלטה על קו החוף ועל נתיב השיט החיוני בבאב אל־מנדב.

tasks.prompt: What does “sustained” mean in the description of attacks on Sanaa?
options: Continuing over a period of time
Limited to a single warning
Secretly cancelled
Directed only at civilians
tasks.correct_answer: Continuing over a period of time
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המילה מתארת תקיפות שנמשכות לאורך זמן ולא אירוע חד־פעמי.

tasks.prompt: How have the Houthis affected the key city of Taiz?
options: They moved Yemen's government there.
They handed its supply route to Saudi Arabia.
They cut the route to Aden, effectively encircling and isolating the city.
They abandoned every position near the city.
tasks.correct_answer: They cut the route to Aden, effectively encircling and isolating the city.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי המקורות, החות'ים ניתקו את נתיב האספקה המחבר את תעז לעדן ובכך כיתרו ובודדו אותה למעשה.

tasks.prompt: Why does the article say Saudi approval was probably needed before al-Alimi's announcement?
options: Saudi Arabia remains the Yemeni government's key backer.
Saudi Arabia controls all Houthi media channels.
Al-Alimi is legally the president of Saudi Arabia.
The United Nations required Riyadh to write the speech.
tasks.correct_answer: Saudi Arabia remains the Yemeni government's key backer.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ערב הסעודית היא התומכת המרכזית בממשלת אל־עלימי, ולכן הכרזה כה חריפה כנראה דרשה אור ירוק מריאד.

tasks.prompt: In the article, what does “lifeblood” suggest about oil for Saudi Arabia?
options: It is used only for military vehicles.
It is less important than coastal trade.
It is an essential source of economic strength.
It has already been completely exhausted.
tasks.correct_answer: It is an essential source of economic strength.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: השימוש במילה מדגיש שהנפט חיוני לכלכלה הסעודית ומהווה מקור מרכזי לעוצמתה הכלכלית.

tasks.prompt: Give two targets or locations mentioned in the exchange of strikes between the Houthis and their opponents.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שני יעדים או אזורים נכונים, כגון אתרי ארמקו בריאד ובח'ורייס, צנעא, סעדה או עמדות ליד תעז.
expected_points: Houthi claims included Aramco sites in Riyadh and the oil-rich Khurais area.
Government or Saudi-led strikes were reported in Sanaa, Saada and positions near Taiz.

tasks.prompt: Summarise how the conflict developed from 2014 to the new all-out-war announcement.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול את השתלטות החות'ים על צנעא ב־2014, ההתערבות הסעודית ב־2015, תקופת הרגיעה, חידוש הלחימה ביולי והמתקפה על החוף שהובילה להסלמה הנוכחית.
expected_points: The Houthis seized Sanaa in 2014, and a Saudi-led coalition intervened in 2015.
After years of relative calm, fighting reignited in July amid wider regional conflict.
A rapid Houthi offensive captured the Red Sea coast, leading the government to announce operations to retake territory.

tasks.prompt: Why could renewed war in Yemen affect countries beyond Yemen and Saudi Arabia?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לקשור בין תקיפת מתקני הנפט, נתיבי השיט בבאב אל־מנדב והורמוז, מחירי או אספקת האנרגיה והכלכלה העולמית.
expected_points: Attacks on Saudi oil facilities threaten a major source of global energy supply.
Control of the Bab al-Mandab affects a vital international shipping lane.
Disruption to oil exports or shipping could have consequences for the global economy.

tasks.prompt: Using evidence from the article, write a short paragraph explaining why Taiz is strategically important in the current fighting.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שתעז בשליטת הממשלה, שהיא בחזית, ושנתיב האספקה לעדן נותק; יש להסביר כיצד בידוד העיר מסייע לחות'ים.
expected_points: Taiz is a key government-held city on the frontline.
Its route to Aden, the government's interim capital, is a vital supply link.
Cutting the route encircles the city and advances the Houthis' military objective without full capture.
